name: Call-outs
what: Point at things in your video: a dot lands on a spot and pulses, a line draws out from it with an elbow, and a title with a small line slides out of its end - several one after another; they draw back at the end.
origin: call-outs - the template kinds marketplaces list (Mixkit, Envato Elements, Motion Array, Videohive), researched 2026-10-16
motion: dot back.out 10 f + a halo every 30 f; line draws 14 f (S-curve); title rises 10 f, the small line 4 f later; 18 f between call-outs; back in reverse 10 f
